character.description: The character to show. Leave it out for an empty box.

show.description: model: the character in black. trace: faint, to write over. empty: guide lines only. Defaults to model with a character, else empty.

guides.description: true (default): the two center lines (田). diagonal: also the diagonals (米). false: none.

label.description: A small label in the corner, and what Marks report as name.
